name: Kispalád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kispalád: a quartered grey and brown oval with a bird, a church, a tree and ears of grain, above a red scroll inscribed KISPALÁD, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kispalád arms with scroll and wreath
